notes: PARTIAL RESULT. A real running Tauri app performed a real Updater::check(), received 1.0.1, derived UpdateIdentity via delta_identity(), reached real Update::install(), and left the installed main binary byte-identical to the expected 1.0.1 binary (old ab689afd..., expected/installed 7b4069ca...). However the flow selected FULL, not Delta. Root cause: Update.target is updater_os() alone -- 'darwin' -- not '{os}-{arch}'. The arch is appended only inside get_urls for its local search and never reaches Update.target (updater.rs:403). Our delta lookup keys on identity.target(), so patch_for('darwin', '1.0.0') found nothing and fell back with reason None. Confirmed at runtime, not only from source. The delta path (patch download, reconstruction) is therefore NOT demonstrated by this run. The patch ratio below was measured at generation time and no client consumed it here. Localhost plain HTTP was intentionally enabled for the harness. (tree_dirty recorded false: the sole uncommitted file at capture was this record.)
